## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Brussels, Belgium. It starts at Rue de l'étuve / Stoofstraat 41.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> This fun and informative workshop will place you under the guidance of an expert chocolatier, who'll teach you how to make your very own chocolate delights.
>
> Kids aged six years and above, as well as chocolate-loving adults, will be taught how to make chocolate lollipops as well as a tasty choco trail mix. It's Belgian culture, cuisine, and fun all in one workshop!
>
> You'll also be able to explore the Choco-Story museum, full of interesting history and fascinating facts about the world's favorite sweet treat, and enjoy a tasting of some real Belgian chocolate.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €50.62. It was rated 4.6 out of 5 from 57 ratings and 43 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
